add_transition.note: Disposable-project UXP write succeeded at an exact cut point; sequence-frame captures confirmed the visible Cross Dissolve. The independently gated remove_transition command also passed a later add/remove/visual-restore roundtrip.

capture_frame.note: Disposable-project UXP sequence-frame export returned verified 1280x720 JPEG images; this remains a Program Monitor frame, not a full-window capture.

create_caption_track.note: Premiere 26.3.2 test-project roundtrip created one native 16-item caption track from an imported SRT. Caption range, all V/A tracks and clips, sequence duration, and three representative sequence-frame renders were verified; UXP remains blocked for caption creation.

create_sequence_from_clips.note: Disposable-project UXP write created a 10-second two-clip sequence with matching video and audio structure. The direct sequence creation API is not undoable.

delete_marker.note: Disposable-project UXP marker deletion succeeded and list_markers confirmed the exact marker was removed.

get_app_preference.note: Premiere 26.3.2 live read returned typed values for all three stable preference keys without changing application state.

get_bin_contents.note: Premiere 26.3.2 and installed UXP 0.6.2 resolved the virtual project root by project GUID and returned the exact two root items. Recursive nested-bin and large-bin fixtures remain untested.

get_clip_adjustment_layer.note: Premiere 26.3.2 live read returned false for the normal video clip; a positive adjustment-layer fixture remains untested.

get_clip_at_position.note: A bounded V1 lookup at 30 seconds resolved the exact third clip and returned matching timeline and source timing.

get_clip_markers.note: The source-marker collection read completed and returned an empty array; a positive source-marker fixture remains untested.

get_clip_properties.note: Live UXP returned the selected third V1 clip's exact timeline/source timing, speed, selection, project-item ID, and media path.

get_clip_speed.note: Live UXP returned multiplier 1, 100 percent, and non-reversed state for the selected video clip.

get_color_label.note: Live UXP returned color-label index 1 for the exact project item.

get_effect_properties.note: Live UXP reads returned the localized Opacity, Motion, and mono Volume components with current values and keyframe metadata.

get_full_clip_info.note: Live UXP returned the complete clip snapshot plus localized Opacity and Motion components and their current values.

get_footage_interpretation.note: Live UXP returned 24 fps, square pixels, alpha/field/VR values, and the zero-GUID input-LUT sentinel for the source clip.

get_caption_tracks.note: Phase B-1 live read verified caption timing windows. Premiere Pro UXP 26.3 does not expose user-edited caption copy: every item returns text:null and textAvailable:false, while getName() is preserved only as kind metadata.

get_item_info.note: Live UXP resolved the exact project item and returned its media path, online/proxy state, label, and footage interpretation.

get_installed_mogrt_path.note: Premiere 26.3.2 returned the installed Motion Graphics Templates directory and the native directory existed.

get_media_encoder_info.note: Premiere 26.3.2 live read confirmed that Adobe Media Encoder is installed.

get_metadata.note: Live UXP returned non-empty project metadata, columns metadata, and XMP payloads in the documented raw-XML response.

get_project_item_info.note: Live UXP returned the exact project-item snapshot and explicitly marked codec and color-space fields as unsupported.

get_project_item_lut_info.note: Installed UXP 0.6.2 returned the requested project-item ID and correctly normalized Premiere's zero-GUID input and embedded LUT sentinels to hasInputLut false and hasEmbeddedLut false.

get_project_ingest_settings.note: Premiere 26.3.2 live read returned the active test project's ingest-disabled state.

get_project_panel_selection.note: Premiere 26.3.2 completed both active-project and all-view bounded selection reads; the current Project panel selection was empty.

get_sequence_markers_by_type.note: Installed UXP 0.6.2 read the active sequence's empty Comment-marker collection without the Premiere 26.3 nullptr failure. A positive typed-marker fixture remains untested.

get_track_info.note: Both V1 and A1 live reads returned three clips with exact start/end values; lock and targeting stay null because official UXP exposes neither getter.

get_value_at_time.note: Using the actual Korean Motion and Scale display names, live UXP returned value 100 at 30 seconds.

list_available_transitions.note: Live UXP read returned 118 official video-transition matchNames. These are stable API identities rather than localized display names.

list_clip_effects.note: Live UXP returned the localized Opacity and Motion components, matchNames, property values, and keyframe metadata.

list_premiere_events.note: Premiere 26.3.2 returned a bounded journal while all six official event groups had 38 active listeners; the journal correctly stated that it was not a state snapshot.

open_project.note: With current-turn user approval, official Project.open() opened the existing test .prproj once. The project disk hash, mtime, sequence duration, and all V/A track structure remained unchanged; no save was called.

find_items_by_media_path.note: A unique filename query found exactly the expected online source item and native media path.

get_export_file_extension.note: EncoderManager returned mp4 for Adobe's installed High Quality 1080 HD EPR; no export or AME job was started.

get_keyframes.note: Using the actual Korean Motion and Scale display names, live UXP returned the valid empty-keyframe path.

get_linked_items.note: Live UXP found all six timeline items that reference the same project item. This is same-source discovery, not Premiere's hidden A/V link-group identity.

get_xmp_metadata.note: Live UXP returned the source clip's non-empty raw XMP packet.

has_proxy.note: Live UXP returned no attached proxy and canProxy true; a positive attached-proxy fixture remains untested.

has_transcript.note: Installed UXP 0.6.2 returned the exact requested project-item ID, source name, and hasTranscript true for the approved test media.

match_frame.note: At playhead 52.1667 seconds, live UXP mapped the selected V1 clip to source time 59.9583 seconds. It reports data only and cannot invoke the Match Frame UI command.

remove_transition.note: User-confirmed disposable test project: added a 0.5-second Cross Dissolve at 25.375 seconds, captured the blended cut, removed the left clip end transition through createRemoveVideoTransitionAction(), and reproduced the exact pre-transition JPEG SHA-256. Full V/A structure, sequence duration, and disk project hash remained unchanged. The public schema accepts position=end only; start/both are rejected until separately verified.

rename_caption_track.note: Premiere 26.3.2 renamed three existing caption tracks in separate bounded official Action transactions. Every call and the final get_caption_tracks read-back returned the exact requested Korean name; cue timing and all V/A structure were preserved.

set_caption_track_mute.note: Premiere 26.3.2 changed two existing caption tracks from unmuted to muted in separate bounded calls, and both calls plus the final get_caption_tracks read-back returned the exact requested values. Caption text and cue timing were unchanged; this direct mute write is not undoable.

set_clip_opacity.note: Disposable-project UXP write changed Opacity from 100 to 99 and restored it to 100 with property readback.

set_clip_scale.note: Disposable-project UXP write changed Motion Scale from 100 to 110 and restored it to 100 with property readback.

set_clip_volume.note: Disposable-project UXP write changed mono clip level from 0 dB to -6 dB and restored 0 dB; raw-amplitude readback matched the conversion.

set_effect_property.note: Disposable-project UXP write changed localized Opacity from 100 to 90 and restored it to 100 with property readback.

undo.note: Premiere 26.3.2 CEP returned ReferenceError because app.project.undo is not a function. Keep unavailable until a real supported code API exists.

is_after_effects_installed.note: Premiere 26.3.2 live read confirmed that After Effects is installed.

has_object_mask.note: Premiere 26.3.2 completed both project and active-sequence object-mask reads; neither contained an object mask.

is_done_analyzing_video_effects.note: Premiere 26.3.2 reported that video-effect analysis for the active sequence was complete.

is_premiere_project.note: Premiere 26.3.2 returned true for the existing test .prproj and false for an existing non-project file.

list_media_encoder_events.note: Premiere 26.3.2 returned a bounded empty AME event journal and explicitly reported that no current queue snapshot is available.

list_transcription_languages.note: Premiere 26.3.2 returned 18 transcription languages, including Korean ko-kr.

subscribe_premiere_events.note: Premiere 26.3.2 registered all six official event groups against the active test sequence and its six tracks, yielding 38 exact listeners.

unsubscribe_premiere_events.note: Premiere 26.3.2 removed all 38 listeners registered by the all-group verification and returned zero active listeners.
